### Data Zone, Locality, HSCP Map

This map shows the borders of Data Zone, Locality, and HSCP for `r params$area`. The borders of the localities are based on new assignments of Data Zones to these localities, provided by those in the Partnership.

Hovering the mouse over the Data Zone will show which Locality it is currently assigned to. Clicking on this Data Zone will show the HSCP, Locality and Data Zone code. 

<!-- Of the 32 HSCPs, `r check_hscp` have returned their new lookup files. -->


```{r, include = FALSE}

  geo_datazone_filtered <- geo_datazone |> 
    filter(hscp2019name == params$area)

  locality_sf <- geo_datazone_filtered |>
    group_by(hscp_locality) |>
    summarise(do_union = TRUE) |>  
    st_make_valid() |> 
    ungroup()
  
  test_locality_sf <- locality_sf |> 
    count(hscp_locality)
  
  hscp_sf <- geo_datazone_filtered |>
    group_by(hscp2019, hscp2019name) |>
    summarise(do_union = TRUE) |>   
    st_make_valid()  |> 
    ungroup()
  
  test_locality_sf <- hscp_sf |> 
    count(hscp2019name)
  
  # print(hscp_sf)
  
  
pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c(
    '#006d77',
    '#C45454',
    '#3e7730',
    '#ff3b75',
    '#F3BA2D',
    '#1d568e',
    '#31A845',
    '#AA3EBD'),
  domain = sort(unique(locality_sf$hscp_locality))
)

shp_data_filtered <- shp_data |> 
    filter(hscp2019na == params$area)
  
```

### {data-height=1000}

```{r}

  base_map <- geo_datazone_filtered %>%
    leaflet()  %>%
    addProviderTiles(
      providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap,
      options = providerTileOptions(opacity = 0.5)
    ) |>
    addPolygons(data = locality_sf,
                weight = 2.5,
                fillColor = ~pal(hscp_locality),
                color = ~pal(hscp_locality),
                fillOpacity = 0.3
    ) |>
    #   addPolygons(data = shp_data_filtered,
    #             weight = 2.5,
    #             color = "black",
    #             # fillColor = ~pal(hscp_locality),
    #             # color = ~pal(hscp_locality),
    #             fillOpacity = 0.3
    # ) |>
    addPolygons(data = geo_datazone_filtered, weight = 0.5, color = "black",
                fillOpacity = 0,
                popup = ~glue("<b><b>HSCP</b>: {hscp2019name} (HSCP Code: {hscp2019})
                                              <br>
                                              <br><b>HSCP Locality</b>: {hscp_locality}
                                              <br>
                                              <br><b>DataZone Code</b>: {datazone2022}"),
                label = ~glue("Locality: {hscp_locality}"),
                highlightOptions = highlightOptions(color = 'white', weight = 3.5, bringToFront = TRUE)) |>
    addLegend(
    data = locality_sf,
    pal = pal,
    values = ~hscp_locality,
    position = "bottomleft",
    title = "Locality Name:",
    opacity = 0.9
  ) 

base_map
```
